rationale: Operator choice 2026-11-13 through the decision rubric. Environment approval gives one deliberate maintainer action per run, enforced by GitHub, and storing the key on the environment means no other workflow can read it, which enforces the ruling that regular workflows never spend. Chosen over the label because the label needs custom code for the push-versus-label race and for who applied it. Counter-argument considered: per-run approval makes the gate a manual step that RFC-0043 meant to remove and makes contributors wait. It survives because outsider volume is about two PRs in the current window and the cost per review is unmeasured; once measured, moving to automatic with a cap is a small change. Creating the environment and moving the secret are operator actions (class c). Applied in AISDLC-1266.
